_about.chapter: Story and missions: the story's parts, chapters, missions and steps; the mission kinds; where the crew's nights out happen; and how the van scene leaves everyone.
_about.how_to_edit: Plain JSON, inlined by tools/build.mjs as GAME_DB.story and checked by tools/test-game-db.cjs. Positions are world px on the named map; a (and angle) are radians: 0 faces east (right), 1.5708 south (down), 3.1416 west, -1.5708 north. A step's name is in save files (StoryManager.serialize) and the code moves between steps by name: never rename one. _about.notes keeps the explanations that were comments in the code, keyed by path.

tables.parts: The story (STORY_DB, story/story-db.js): Part → chapters → missions → steps, each keyed by its number. A mission has its name, desc, location, locationDesc, completionTime, target, its steps (in order) and optional side quests (id, name, trigger, steps). A step has a name, the banner shown when it starts (null: none), targetMap and target (the landmark its marker points at, or player), and condition: a string the story checks each frame (LOC_<map> she's on that map, TIMER_<n>, or a named check in StoryManager.checkCondition), or null for a step that ends the chain. A step with code names it in hooks (STORY_STEP_HOOKS in story/story-db.js): its onStart, and its condition when that's a function.
tables.mission_types: The kinds of side job (MISSION_TYPES, story/missions.js). Saves keep these values.
tables.crew: The crew's nights out (story/crew-nights.js): ids (each one's id, CREW_IDS), venues (CREW_VENUES: the map, label, what the night is, its host, and where everyone sits or stands for a group night and a solo one; me, them and seats are x, y, a and an optional pose; cam and zoom frame it; after is where she stands when it's over), and home_venue (each one's own place, CREW_HOME_VENUE).
tables.van: The end of the van scene (story/scenes/van.js): drop is where the van and everyone stand (VAN_DROP), poses how each one sits in the back (VAN_POSES), deposit Mirabel's payment up front (MIRABEL_DEPOSIT).

notes.parts[\"1\"].chapters[\"1\"].missions[\": Steps are addressed by name (story.goTo / isAt / isBefore). The numbers are just their order; saves keep the name (StoryManager.serialize).
The van ride and the night before (story/scenes/van.js). Ends at the hotel door.
Out of the van: she walks (the move stick), the door pill shows her how to go in
The lobby: Seven holds it; the elevator to the penthouse
The penthouse: she draws her FP-X (the fire stick), and walks in deeper
The red light, the wall blows in, the drones
The aftermath: search the rubble; Yenna spots the note
Josh's rage, then out before the news arrives: the BlackMark is at the curb
Mirabel, in person for the first time: the balance, and her favour
